_comment: ENSv2 contracts are beta and explicitly not final. Pin the exact addresses used and record them here so a breaking upstream change is diagnosable rather than mysterious.

policyRepointTxs._comment: A live exercise of the owner-only policy repoint path (AgentSubnameRegistrar.setPolicyHash). The record was moved to a new hash and back again; the hook could not follow, because a live AgentPolicyHook cannot be replaced (see docs/future-work.md). Kept because it is the only on-chain proof that owner-only repointing works.
policyRepointTxs.label: trader
